svg.title: Подъём таза с пятками на возвышении — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Heels-elevated glute bridge. Clear side three-quarter view. Athlete on his back on floor, head, shoulders and arms stay on floor, BOTH heels placed on top of a stable low rectangular step box. Toes point up, only heels touch the step. Left: pelvis on floor, knees bent. Right: hips lifted to form a straight line from shoulders through hips to knees, knees remain bent, both heels in exactly the same place on the same box. No external weight, bench under torso, or ball. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
